title: 4 Things CISOs Should Prioritize Over the AI Hype
content_md: Lately, security vendors have been giving the message that the world is burning, that AI has completely reshaped cybersecurity, and that anyone with a prompt now has the capabilities of a nation-state. As always, there’s some truth to this, and it would be naive to dismiss how AI is shaping the security landscape. But one has to wonder what’s behind all the hype, and what still matters in security today that mattered 5, 10, 15, even 20 years ago. Article Link: 4 Things CISOs Should Prioritize Over the AI Hype
